summary: The compliance review of the KYCFast product, which includes Video KYC and Biometric Onboarding, identified several high-risk issues against the reviewed RBI rules. The product feature 'Data Collection' may imply the collection of biometric data without explicit clarification, which could violate the prohibition on storing or collecting biometric data by RE and LSP unless permitted by law.
